text: Entry 1464 moves the Storybook documentation under mail/components/storybook/docs and removes the duplicate component README. The accepted docs/config.yml maps the storybook documentation root to that directory, and the local index links create_story and running_storybook. For this component documentation, recommend keeping the published root mapping synchronized with physical file moves. This source change does not establish a rule that every Thunderbird document belongs beside its implementation. No test, build or runtime operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source adoption does not establish reviewer approval.
